summary: Teradata Corporation filed an 8-K on August 12, 2026, disclosing that its Board approved a form of Indemnification Agreement and entered into such agreements with each director and executive officer. The agreement indemnifies and advances expenses to the fullest extent permitted under Delaware law and provides D&O insurance coverage. This is a routine governance matter, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved. The filing is purely administrative and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
